title: Leak Calls in Rainy Season Explained for Landlords (Video)

findings.quote: the repair clock starts when you get notice
findings.root_cause: Civil Code 1942(a) is specific to notice of untenantable conditions; phrasing sweeps in all reports.
findings.fix: Replace 'the repair clock starts when you get notice' with 'Once you receive notice of a condition affecting habitability, respond within a reasonable time for the circumstances; document and investigate every leak report.'
findings.future_prevention: Apply the same correction to parent article, video page, and script; verify before publication.

findings.root_cause: Operational emergency classification is not by itself a legal determination that emergency entry is warranted.
findings.fix: Replace 'Emergency entry without notice (§1954)' with 'Emergency entry without advance notice only where circumstances constitute an actual emergency under §1954; otherwise use statutory notice or applicable consent.'
findings.future_prevention: Apply the same correction to parent article, video page, and script; verify before publication.

findings.future_prevention: Apply the same correction to parent article, video page, and script; verify before publication.

findings.root_cause: Specific portfolio counts need independently accessible internal data or human verification; published assertion of confirmation does not independently substantiate them.
findings.fix: Replace 'our portfolio of 600+ East Bay units logged four weather-related maintenance requests' with 'our portfolio received weather-related maintenance reports' until the exact counts and comparisons have been independently documented.
findings.future_prevention: Apply the same correction to parent article, video page, and script; verify before publication.

findings.quote: water actively coming in is an emergency on our 24/7 line, with a vendor sent the same day
findings.root_cause: The repository verifies 24/7 bilingual maintenance, not an unconditional same-day vendor dispatch commitment.
findings.fix: Replace 'with a vendor sent the same day' with 'which we prioritize for same-day assessment and vendor dispatch, subject to the circumstances' unless AEBP confirms the stronger service guarantee.
findings.future_prevention: Apply the same correction to parent article, video page, and script; verify before publication.
